directions.label: The Counter
directions.premise: Treat the screen as a working pâtisserie counter: products, service cues and practical information occupy a shared horizontal field where attention moves from overview to one chosen item.
directions.spatialModel: A continuous working surface with depth, edge, reach and product zones; the user scans laterally before attention narrows.
directions.compositionModel: Wide horizontal staging, generous physical gaps, large product zones and a persistent service rail; asymmetry comes from object placement rather than editorial collage.
directions.typographicBehavior: Direct, warm and highly legible sans-led hierarchy with large spoken headings; type sits on the same working plane as products instead of becoming a fashion masthead.
directions.colorBehavior: Cool food-service neutrals, stainless and warm butter tones with one appetite accent; avoid the peach/cream palette from the first proof.
directions.imageRole: Truthful product and hand-scale photography is primary; imagery must show reach, selection, wrapping or serving rather than isolated luxury still life.
directions.materialModel: Stainless steel, paper wrap, tray edges, pastry crumb and glass translated as crisp surface relationships without skeuomorphic decoration.
directions.motionMetaphor: Attention travels across the counter: a product is noticed, brought forward, prepared and returned into context through measured spatial shifts.
directions.interactionExpression: Pointer/tap changes service focus locally; selection pulls one item into a clear service zone while preserving the larger counter context.
directions.responsiveExpression: Desktop feels like standing at a counter; mobile becomes a vertical hand-service lane where one item at a time comes within thumb reach.
directions.soundPolicy: Silence by default; optional subtle wrapping or tray contact only if it reinforces a specific handoff state.
antiPatterns: rounded SaaS cards as service zones

directions.label: The Handoff
directions.premise: Make transfer itself the visual identity: requests cross a threshold, are transformed through preparation, and return as something ready to receive.
directions.spatialModel: Two fields separated by an active threshold; content repeatedly crosses, pauses, changes state and completes on the receiving side.
directions.compositionModel: Strong directional bands and opposing fields with large negative space; the threshold is the compositional anchor rather than a physical counter.
directions.typographicBehavior: Compressed, graphic display statements paired with restrained reading text; words may cross or align to the threshold to reinforce transfer without becoming decorative typography theater.
directions.colorBehavior: Deep aubergine and near-black against pale pastry paper with a sharp apricot transfer signal; high contrast and deliberately non-café-pastel.
directions.imageRole: Images appear as evidence moving through states: source, preparation crop, finished result and handoff; a single frame may show transformation rather than a static beauty shot.
directions.materialModel: Paper folds, cut edges, transfer marks and clean shadow planes; materials describe passing and wrapping rather than nostalgia.
directions.motionMetaphor: Everything consequential crosses a boundary: request enters, preparation compresses, result passes through, confirmation settles.
directions.interactionExpression: User actions create directional transfer; selected content moves toward the user while previous context recedes instead of opening modal/card layers.
directions.responsiveExpression: Mobile turns the threshold vertical: choices move upward into preparation and completed information returns into the lower thumb zone.
directions.soundPolicy: No ambient sound; one restrained handoff cue may mark completed service if sound is enabled.
antiPatterns: decorative arrows used as the whole concept

directions.label: The Conversation
directions.premise: Treat service as a short human exchange: the interface asks, listens, narrows and responds, allowing appetite and practical intent to shape what appears next.
directions.spatialModel: A responsive conversational field where one prompt and one answer hold focus; product evidence enters as the consequence of the exchange.
directions.compositionModel: Large typographic turns, variable whitespace and minimal persistent chrome; each state is composed around one question, response or recommendation rather than a fixed page grid.
directions.typographicBehavior: Typography is the primary actor: expressive but readable prompts, quieter answers and unmistakable action language; no default metadata voice or technical mono layer.
directions.colorBehavior: Near-white and ink with one bright citron attention state plus occasional product-derived color; deliberately graphic and contemporary rather than warm-luxury coded.
directions.imageRole: Product imagery appears only after the user's intent becomes specific; images function as answers, not wallpaper.
directions.materialModel: Almost immaterial interface with selective paper/packaging fragments appearing at preparation and handoff moments; materiality arrives as response.
directions.motionMetaphor: Call and response: prompts hold, answers arrive, the field clears, and the next service turn enters with conversational timing rather than continuous scroll spectacle.
directions.interactionExpression: Tap/click choices behave like answers; the interface immediately reformulates the next state and preserves an obvious path back without chatbot chrome.
directions.responsiveExpression: Mobile is the native form: one prompt, one set of choices, one immediate answer; desktop uses scale and whitespace rather than adding complexity.
directions.soundPolicy: Silent by default; no simulated voice or chat sound effects.
